title: Langar Queue
brief: 50 visitors arrive in waves: shoes off, hands washed, heads covered, then seated. Keep the line moving and seat everyone. Budget ₹12,000. Finish in 3 min.

mistri.brief: Visitors are arriving. Get everyone to a seat promptly.

hints.QUEUE_OVERFLOW: Look at the red marker. That is where the line is held up.
hints.UNDERUSED_HALL: Look at the red marker. That is where the line is held up.
hints.CROSS_FLOW: After eating, which way do people leave?
hints.NO_PATH: Visitors need a route to the hall.
hints.default: Where is the longest line? Start there.

insight.title: The bottleneck sets the speed
insight.principle: A line moves only as fast as its slowest step. Fix that step first; speeding up any other step changes nothing.
insight.example: When airport security lines grow, they open more scanners, not more check-in desks. Factories call this the Theory of Constraints.
insight.number: One shoe stand at 4 s a person serves 15 people a minute. 50 people in 80 s is 37 a minute, so you need 3.
insight.quote: First find where the line is held up, then spend money.
